title: Snap Apps statement extraction — v1, per-page chunk
description: Strict output contract for ONE CHUNK of a bank/card statement (`docs/STATEMENTS.md` §12 T2). This is the SECOND schema in this codebase, deliberately a sibling of extraction-schema.json rather than a widened version of it — a statement's nouns (a period, a running balance, a sequence of movements) are genuinely different from a receipt's (goods, GST categories, a payable amount). The unit of extraction is a PAGE, not a whole document: a 300-row statement cannot be read in one model call without hitting the shared output-token cap (`extraction/provider.ts`'s TruncatedOutputError), so `extraction/statement-run.ts` sends one page (or a small run of pages) per call and stitches the results back into one statement. A chunk that shows a 'balance brought forward'/'balance carried forward' line — common at the top of every page after the first — must report that figure in opening_balance, NEVER as a row in `lines`: doing the latter would count that money twice when chunks are stitched together.

page_range.description: The 1-based page numbers THIS chunk covers, within the whole statement. Not asked of the model in the wire format sent to it — supplied by the caller and echoed back here so a stored chunk result is self-describing on replay.

opening_balance.description: This chunk's own opening/brought-forward balance, when it prints one — typically page 1's header, or a carried-forward figure restated at the top of a later page. null (with a null_reason) on every chunk that shows neither.

closing_balance.description: This chunk's own closing/carried-forward balance, when it prints one — typically the statement's final page or summary block.

lines.description: Every transaction row printed on this chunk's pages, in the order printed. Never a 'balance brought forward' / 'balance carried forward' row — see opening_balance / closing_balance above.

posted_date.description: The date this movement cleared. Destined for transactions.settled_date (docs/STATEMENTS.md §5.1).

value_date.description: Only when the statement prints a SEPARATE value date from the posted date.

description.description: As printed, verbatim. Never normalised, never paraphrased.

amount_signed.description: The change to the account's OWN PRINTED running balance for this row: (balance after) minus (balance before). Positive when the balance rose, negative when it fell — the page's own arithmetic, not a ledger convention. If the statement instead prints separate debit/credit columns, a debit is negative here and a credit is positive.

running_balance.description: The balance printed immediately after this row, when the statement prints one.

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits ONLY, when a card number appears against this row. Never return a full or partial PAN beyond 4 digits — masked again in code regardless (`extraction/types.ts#maskCardLast4`).

legible.description: Is this chunk a true and clear reproduction of its pages?

null_reason.description: REQUIRED whenever value is null. 'not_present' (this chunk genuinely does not show it), 'illegible' (present but unreadable), 'ambiguous' (several candidates, no basis to choose).

MoneyField.description: Decimal amount in the statement's own currency, as a string so precision is never lost to floating point. Return the number as printed (or as computed per amount_signed's own rule); never round, never convert currency.
